integrity: The weighted-conformal infinity mass is taken directly from the published construction. The three asymptotic regimes are proved from explicit Gaussian likelihood-ratio identities, Gaussian maximum bounds, a fractional-moment argument, and an exact critical truncation calculation. The verifier checks algebraic and numerical consequences only; it is not used as an infinite-sample proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes one-dimensional unit-variance Gaussian source and target covariates, a known exact likelihood ratio, fixed miscoverage level, and finite calibration scores. The exact critical statement treats \(\delta_n=\sqrt{2\log n}\); second-order critical windows, estimated or clipped weights, and finite-width behavior below the transition are not classified.
title: A sharp overlap phase for Gaussian weighted conformal prediction
